newsitem.title: USA: B/E Aerospace, Harris in venture.
newsitem.headline: B/E Aerospace, Harris in venture.

text.p: B/E Aerospace Inc said Tuesday it formed a joint venture with Harris Corp to provide live television broadcasts to airline passengers.
The manufacturer of aircraft cabin interior products said it will control a 51 percent voting interest in the venture, while Harris of Melbourne, Fla., will have the remaining 49 percent.
B/E Aerospace said it will provide the individual seat distribution systems and Harris the specialized aircraft antenna and receiver systems.

"This joint venture represents a tremendous opportunity for B/E Aerospace tp participate in the expected rapid marketplace expansion for in-seat video entertainment systems into narrow-body aircraft," said chief executive Robert Khoury in a statement.
He added existing and forecast narrow-body fleets represent a total market potential of about $3 billion for the systems.
